article_summaries.title: Questions & Answers - Free Realms Forums
article_summaries.summary: This is a captured thread-index page of the fan forum's Questions & Answers section (June 2009), listing player-started threads with reply counts and last-post times. It contains no official answers or verified mechanics; the thread titles only show what players were asking about in the live game, such as where to find items, Explorer coins, and a price display question.
